evals.prompt:
Add a Java main that constructs a Person with a name and prints it.
class Person { String name; }
evals.expected_output: Umple with public static void main and new Person(...).
expectations: The Umple source contains 'public static void main'
The main body is tagged Java { or Java{
The API was called with language=Java
The API response does not contain umple-message-error

evals.prompt:
Generate a main that turns a Light off then on.
class Light { sm { On { off -> Off; } Off { on -> On; } } }
evals.expected_output: Main calls off() and on() (or equivalent event methods).
expectations: The Umple source contains a main method
The main invokes the off event and the on event
The API response does not contain umple-message-error
